description: This is a C source file implementing a display driver for the GC9X01X display controller in the Zephyr RTOS. It includes functions for initializing the display, configuring pixel format and orientation, transmitting commands via SPI, and managing power states.

methods.name: gc9x01x_transmit
methods.description: Sends a command and optional data to the display via SPI, toggling GPIO levels for command/data distinction.

methods.name: gc9x01x_regs_init
methods.description: Initializes display registers with default and configuration-specific commands.

methods.name: gc9x01x_exit_sleep
methods.description: Exits sleep mode and enables the display.

methods.name: gc9x01x_enter_sleep
methods.description: Puts the display into sleep mode (power saving).

methods.name: gc9x01x_hw_reset
methods.description: Performs hardware reset of the display via GPIO.

methods.name: gc9x01x_set_pixel_format
methods.description: Configures the pixel format (RGB565 or RGB888).

methods.name: gc9x01x_configure
methods.description: Configures display settings including register init, pixel format, and orientation.

methods.name: gc9x01x_init
methods.description: Initializes the display device, including reset, configuration, and exiting sleep mode.

methods.name: gc9x01x_set_mem_area
methods.description: Sets the memory area (region) for subsequent pixel data writes.

methods.name: gc9x01x_write
methods.description: Writes pixel data to the display within a specified region.

methods.name: gc9x01x_get_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities such as supported pixel formats and resolution.
